text.en: In spartacus-features.module.ts, set authorizationCodeFlowByDefault, incrementProcessesCountForMergeCart, dispatchLoginActionOnlyWhenTokenReceived and cdsLoginEventsToken to true. They enable OAuth 2.1 support, which uses Authorization Code Flow with a browser redirect.
text.tr: spartacus-features.module.ts içinde authorizationCodeFlowByDefault, incrementProcessesCountForMergeCart, dispatchLoginActionOnlyWhenTokenReceived ve cdsLoginEventsToken değerlerini true yapın. Bunlar, tarayıcı yönlendirmeli Authorization Code Flow kullanan OAuth 2.1 desteğini etkinleştirir.
